vectors.cite: Register-register table, ADDR row, pdf 53; status bits S3.1.2, pdf 45; instruction fetch figure, pdf 28
vectors.derivation: The register table (pdf 53) prints ADDR SSS, DDD as 0011 SSS DDD, 6 cycles, 'ADD contents of Register SSS to contents of register DDD. Results to DDD', status change S, Z, C, OV. S3.1.2 (pdf 45): C is set when the add produces a carry out of the high bit, OV when it produces two's complement overflow, Z when the result is all zero, S when the high-order bit is one. SSS = 001 (R1), DDD = 010 (R2): $7FFF + $0001 = $8000. No carry out of bit 15 (the sum is below $10000), so C = 0. Both addends are positive (bit 15 = 0) and the sum has bit 15 = 1, so OV = 1. S = 1 (bit 15 of $8000), Z = 0. Init S = 0, Z = 1, OV = 0, C = 1. Fetch (pdf 28): FETCH at cycle 0 from R7 = $1000, one word; the unit is the printed 6 cycles with no further bus access. The row has no Not Interruptable note, so prev_interruptible goes 0 -> 1. Registers and memory not named stay unchanged.
